description: Copy chosen pages of a PDF into a new PDF, in the order listed. Also works to reorder, duplicate or drop pages. Saves as name-extracted.pdf beside the original unless output is set.

output.description: Where to save the result. Defaults to the original's name with -extracted, in the same folder.

overwrite.description: Replace the output file if it already exists. Defaults to false.

pages.description: Pages in order, such as "1-3, 7, 10-", "5-1" for reverse, "odd", "even" or "last".

name: pdf_extract_pages
title: Extract PDF pages
